notes: Two bên ... lə pairs: each bên takes the between opening its own pair and each lamed the and written for it, counted pair by pair under rule 26's lə-member sentence.
Unlike v3, this verse writes no preposition before bêṯ ʾābîhā, so its in is placed on the noun under rule 33, while the supplied copula being joins the bi of binʿurêhā under rule 49.
ʾēlleh is the subject and haḥuqqîm the predicate, so the copula joins the noun and the article takes the written the (rule 20); the object marker before Moses is unrepresented under rule 16.
